subject: FintechCo: performance readout - locking slot and pre-readout asks
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@fintechco.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed readout windows + draft agenda (performance/latency)

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for running the test harness last week. We have the perf artifacts from our side and would like to schedule a short readout to walk through results, runbook for reproducing, and next steps (PO / procurement handoff).

Suggested 1-hour windows next week (PST):
- Tue 11 May 10:00–11:00
- Wed 12 May 14:00–15:00
- Thu 13 May 09:00–10:00

Agenda (draft) attached: readout-agenda.md
1) 5m introductions + scope
2) 25m results walkthrough (latency P50/P95, throughput, error modes)
3) 15m open questions + action owners
4) 15m procurement / next steps (PO, billing, security evidence)

Rishi and Karthik from our SE team will cover the technical readout. Monica from CS will join for the transition. If none of these windows work, tell us two that do and we’ll lock it.

CC: rishi, karthik — any special data or artifacts you want included?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: readout-agenda.md (text)

From: Alice Nguyen <alice@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: tim.carter@fintechco.com, procurement@fintechco.com, security@fintechco.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed readout windows + draft agenda (performance/latency)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick follow-up.

Quick constraints from our side:
- Procurement needs the billing terms and draft PO language up front; they prefer the procurement block on Thursdays 09:00–11:00. procurement@fintechco.com is looped.
- Security (Sandra) wants a short pre-readout packet (SOC2 scope + ephemeral logs retention policy) shared at least 72 hours prior.
- Platform eng (Tim) prefers the readout after 13:00 PST so he can join after the on-call rotation.

Can we aim for Wed 19 May 14:00–15:00 PST? If Rishi/Karthik have a hard dependency on earlier testing, let us know. Also please share the perf_results_summary.csv and SOC2-summary.pdf to speed the security review.

—Alice
Alice Nguyen
Eng Manager, Platform — FintechCo

Folks — quick update and apologies for the back-and-forth.

Because procurement had a hard block on Thu mornings and Security asked for a short pre-call, we consolidated:
- Pre-readout security sync: Fri 21 May 09:00–09:20 PST (Sandra confirmed)
- Readout: Fri 21 May 14:00–15:00 PST (final)

Action items captured and owners:
- Marissa: send finalized billing_terms_draft.docx PDF to procurement (done) and DocuSign link for PO (will follow).
- Rishi & Karthik: finalize slides + quick live replay at start (if Tim is on) — deliver by Thu 20 May EOD. perf_results_summary.csv attached.
- Monica: transition checklist + invoicing contact (Monica will be on the readout).
- Sandra: will join the 09:00 pre-readout and confirm evidence scope.

Attachments included: perf_results_summary.csv, billing_terms_draft.docx, SOC2-summary.pdf

I'll send the calendar invites right after this email (one for the pre-readout + one for the readout). Please accept or propose an alternative by EOD Monday if there is a hard conflict.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
